caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded lace object resembling a cap or bonnet, positioned slightly to the right of the center of the image. The lace has intricate patterns composed of zigzags, waves, and geometric shapes rendered in fine, dark lines, giving a sense of texture and depth. The object is shaded to suggest form and volume, while the rest of the background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or patterns. The lower right of the image contains the handwritten name “Richard Whitaker.” The entire composition is monochromatic, utilizing shades of grey and black on a light background.
title: Baby's Cap
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
